reference_transcript: ሕመምተኛው ለ 3 ቀን high-grade fever እና severe ሳል አለው።
Prescribe Amoxicillin 500mg capsules, TID for 7 days ከምግብ በኋላ።
ሕፃኑ ትንፋሽ ማጠር እና wheezing ስላለው nebulization ያስፈልገዋል።
የሽንት ማቃጠል (Dysuria) እና lower abdominal pain አላት። Check urine analysis.
Pediatric suspension 125mg/5mL, 5mL PO TID ለ 5 days ይወሰድ።
ደሟን ስንለካ Fasting blood sugar 240 mg/dL አሳይቷል። Metformin 500mg BID ጀምርላት።
BP 160/100 mmHg አለው። Bilateral lower extremity edema ስላለው Echocardiogram እና LFT, RFT order አድርግ።
ሕመምተኛው chills, rigor እና intermittent fever አለው። Blood film for Malaria species እና CBC check አድርግ።
Gravida 3 Para 2 at 38 weeks gestation. Regular uterine contractions እና ruptured membranes አሏት።
Right lower quadrant rebound tenderness አለው። Acute appendicitis rule out ለማድረግ ultrasound እና WBC count እዘዝ።
ለ 3 ሳምንት የቆየ chronic cough, night sweats እና weight loss ስላለው GeneXpert for TB እና Chest X-ray ያስፈልገዋል።
target_terms: Chronic cough; night sweats; GeneXpert; TB

reference_transcript: ሕፃኑ severe vomiting እና watery diarrhea አለው። Signs of severe dehydration ስላለው IV Normal Saline bolus ጀምርለት።
Involved in RTA with loss of consciousness for 10 minutes. Urgent Head CT scan እና cervical spine X-ray order አድርግ።
target_terms: RTA; loss of consciousness; CT; cervical spine

reference_transcript: Generalized maculopapular rash እና severe pruritus አለው። Discontinue Ceftriaxone immediately.
Severe headache, neck stiffness እና photophobia አለው። Kernig's sign positive ነው። Rule out meningitis.
target_terms: Neck stiffness; photophobia; Kernig's sign; meningitis
